description: Every Match Charting Project stat family for ONE charted match, both players, with the per-set split (set 1, set 2, ..., Total) exactly as charted. Charting ids are their own id space (1960 to 2026). Most of these matches have no counterpart in the live tables. Requires the ULTRA plan.

charting_match_id.description: Charting match id, in its own id space. Not a match_id.

name: get_charting_match

families.description: Every stat family, per player, with the per-set split.

mcp_id.description: The Match Charting Project's own row identifier.

message.description: Human-readable summary of the result, safe to relay to the user verbatim.

ok.description: True when the request succeeded, including when the answer is an empty list. False for a missing or rejected key, a plan that does not include this data, an unknown id, a rate limit or a network error. The message then says what to do. check_api_status is the exception: it is true whenever the API answered, and reports API key problems in the message.

title: Charting: one match, every stat family
